en: Now that's it for this module. We
implemented the
MVC pattern
and we also had a look at CRUD.
CRUD were these 4 operations: creating,
reading, updating, and deleting, which you
need in almost all applications you're going
to build.
And you also saw how CRUD and MVC work
together by passing data around and by using
a model for storing and fetching and
updating your data.
We're still only storing data in a dummy
variable which is lost as soon as the app
reloads, but we'll fix and improve that in
the database module.
One other important thing which we saw in
this module here
is the use of dynamic route segments, as
here for getting a single element or for
deleting an element.
Such dynamic segments enable you to set up
routes that work with any kind of data, for
example, with any kind of goal ID to then
return that ID, delete that ID, or whatever
your application might need to do.
And with that, we got all the core knowledge
and all the core features of Deno and Oak
covered that enable us to build more amazing
applications.
So as a next step, I would suggest that we
also see how we can use a real database.
